questions.question: Normalise to 3NF: Student(StudentID, Name, CourseID, CourseName, TutorID, TutorName)

points.text: FDs: StudentID->Name, CourseID->CourseName, TutorID, TutorID->TutorName. 1NF: atomic. 2NF: remove partial FD (CourseID->CourseName). Course(CourseID, CourseName, TutorID), Tutor(TutorID, TutorName), Student(StudentID, Name, CourseID). 3NF: remove transitive FD (TutorID->TutorName). Already in 3NF
